import java.util.Scanner;

public class LuckyTickets {

    private static final int MOD = 998244353;

    private static long power(long b, long e) {
        long res = 1;
        b %= MOD;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = (res * b) % MOD;
            b = (b * b) % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner reader = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = reader.nextInt() / 2;
        int k = reader.nextInt();
        int[] allowedDigits = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            allowedDigits[i] = reader.nextInt();
        }

        // dp[i][sum] = number of ways to form i digits with sum 'sum'
        int maxSum = n * 9;
        long[][] dp = new long[n + 1][maxSum + 1];
        dp[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int sum = 0; sum <= maxSum; sum++) {
                if (dp[i][sum] == 0) continue;
                for (int digit : allowedDigits) {
                    int newSum = sum + digit;
                    if (newSum <= maxSum) {
                        dp[i + 1][newSum] = (dp[i + 1][newSum] + dp[i][sum]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long result = 0;
        for (int sum = 0; sum <= maxSum; sum++) {
            long count = dp[n][sum];
            result = (result + count * count) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
